<thought>To obtain the precursors, I first need the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the DIBAL‑H reduction of an ester to an aldehyde. I will search the template catalog for a template that breaks an ester functional group and forms an aldehyde, with a carbonyl bond order change from double to single.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehyde"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=O (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
